title: First release
summary: The first release of the APES intranet. Sign in with your APES Cloudron account and find your way round with the new menu.

added: Sign in with your APES Cloudron account. What you can see depends on your intranet groups.
A menu that shows only the pages you can use, on desktop, tablet and mobile.
You can install the intranet on your phone or computer, like an app.
Friendly error pages and a privacy notice.
accessibility: Every change is checked for keyboard use, contrast and screen-reader labels.

internal_notes: From this release, work ships once per milestone: one merge, one release and one deploy.
